usages.explain: Accompanied by negative expressions and an extreme example to convey that, realistically, such a thing wouldn't happen, but the speaker strongly wishes it would.

examples.content: まさか彼に面と向かって「嘘つき」とも言えないじゃないか。
examples.transcription: まさかかれにめんとむかって「うそつき」ともいえないじゃないか。
examples.mean: I couldn't even tell him he was a liar to his face.

title: まさか... => There's no way; that's impossible; you must be joking
